content: Android GitHub Actions CI pitfalls when adding to existing project: use gradle/actions/setup-gradle for dependency caching; chmod +x gradlew; JDK 17; avoid running full gradle build when assembleDebug/testDebugUnitTest suffices; enable org.gradle.caching; increase JVM heap for OOM; signing via env vars not committed files; Gradle Managed Devices preferred over raw emulators for instrumented tests.
